ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE
Application are invited for one Guest faculty (Assistant Professor) in the Centre for Systems
Biology & Bioinformatics, Panjab University, Chandigarh to be filled in through Walk-in-interview,
purely on temporary basis, for the academic session 2023-24.
Essential Qualification for the post of Assistant Professor
(iv) Good academic record as define by the concerned University with at least 55% of the
marks (50% in case of SC/ST/Physically & Visually handicapped) or an equivalent grade
in a point wherever grading system is followed at Master's degree level i.e. Masters in
Computer Science/lnformation Technology and related area from an Indian
University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University.
Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC/ CSIR.
The candidates, who are, or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the
University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of Ph.D.
Degree) Regulations, 2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of the minimum
eligibility condition of NET for recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or
equivalent positions in Universitiees/Colleges/Institutions.

(vi)
Desirable
Ph.D. degree in Computer Science/Information Technology and related area with at least
two-years of research experience or teaching experience of post-graduate classes in the
field of respective subject with relevant publication/s in peer reviewed journals.
The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token of honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to undertake
that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency
and will do the same till they are teaching in Centre for Systems Biology & Bioinformatics as
a Guest Faculty.
Applications should reach via email on or before 19.02.2024 at csbb2007@pu.ac.in.
Walk in Interview will be held on 20.02.2024 at 12:00 noon in the Office of the Chairperson,
Centre for Systems Biology & Bioinformatics, South Campus Sector-25, Panjab University
Chandigarh. No TAA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
